sloka: स तं यदा परिश्रान्तमिन्द्रं जज्ञे ऽथ रावणिः ।तदैनं मायया बद्ध्वा स्वसैन्यमभितो ऽनयत् ।। ७.२९.२९ ॥
transliteration: sa taṁ yadā pariśrāntamindraṁ jajñe 'tha rāvaṇiḥ ।tadainaṁ māyayā baddhvā svasainyamabhito 'nayat ।। 7.29.29 ॥

translations.english: When Ravana's son knew Indra to be exhausted, he then bound him with illusion and led him around his own army.
